status: fixed and verified in isolated instances
root_owned_integration: server.py handles matching approval_expired events and rejects time.time() >= expires_at before writing stdin
implementation: One lazily started stdin reader thread and queue per worker; Pro waits use the remaining monotonic task deadline. Expiry emits a ticket-specific event and raises TimeExceeded into the existing real partial-patch capture path. Non-Pro waits keep their unlimited manual-confirmation behavior.

Real Manager.pump cleared pending, rejected old/expired tickets, completed cleanup, and Queues.consume associated only this attempt's partial patch with the next evaluation stage.
Stopping a real running Pro command cancelled the worker, paused its queue, cleaned its container and did not auto-evaluate.
